English title: A first plot from owned values
Chinese title: 从自有数据绘制首张图
English purpose: Construct a scatter from owned native values and publish content-sized outlined SVG.
Chinese purpose: 从自有原生数据构造散点图，发布按内容定尺寸的轮廓 SVG。

English purpose: One Canvas combines automatic-position callbacks, cell values, estimate labels, Waterfall totals, certified Forest powers and SI/common factors.
Chinese purpose: 同一 Canvas 展示自动刻度格式回调、单元格数值、估计标签、瀑布图合计、森林图认证幂值和 SI／公共因子。

English title: Data anchoring and independent text fitting
Chinese title: 数据锚定与独立文本适配
English purpose: A typed data reference stays fixed while a separate TextPanel heading permits local shrinking or ellipsis; both SVG forms replay one frozen Output.
Chinese purpose: 类型化数据参照保持固定，独立 TextPanel 标题允许局部缩小或省略；两种 SVG 形式复用同一个冻结 Output。
